page.overview:
Who is Brandon Zimmerset?

Brandon Zimmerset is the former margrave of Westruun, Tal'Dorei. He was appointed after the Chroma Crisis and held the position until 822 PD.

After his appointment as margrave, Zimmerset planned to restore Westruun to his former glory and had worries he shared with his councilors about the level of organization of the Ravagers.

Appointed after the Chroma Crisis, in the peace that followed, Zimmerset wanted to restore Westruun to its former glory, a plan resented by some rebellious Westruunian students and traders who believe Westruun was never "glorious" under the rule of a margrave. Zimmerset resides with his family in the Margrave's Keep in Westruun's Opal Ward.

In the adventure hook Counter-espionage in the Tal'Dorei Campaign Setting, which is set in 812 PD, Zimmerset is nearing the end of a three-year investigation into the Clasp's headquarters in Westruun, with information on Spirelings Gholesh, Oalan, and Fetch. However, unbeknownst to the margrave, he has been given misinformation by secret Clasp plant Winston Destwiler, and the Clasp leaders, aware of his investigation, have set into motion a plot to ambush and assassinate the margrave.
